notes.title: 🎄 Patch 0.5 Announcement + New Trailer for Act 3! 🎥
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of all, a big thank you for your support and the great feedback on the game!  
I’m excited to announce [b]Patch 0.5[/b]! The update will be released before New Year’s and brings some exciting improvements.  

[h3]💥 Highlights of Patch 0.5:[/h3] 
[list]  
[*] [b]New animations for players and enemies[/b] – including movement, combat, and patrol animations for a more immersive experience.
[*] [b]AI overhaul[/b] – enemies patrol smarter, track last known positions, and reset if stuck.  
[*] [b]Ghost mode[/b] – no more getting stuck after death; move freely as a ghost.  
[*] And more small tweaks!
[/list] 
I hope you’ll enjoy the upcoming changes! Wishing you all a Merry Christmas and a wonderful holiday season! 🎅✨  

Your developer,  
smi.

[previewyoutube=ZmTIvY5VXZU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patchnotes 0.4 - ACT III and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218682/b425cee7658e15962cd210357debbce1017a369e.png[/img]

[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Act 3:[/b] Face fresh challenges in the narrow alleyways. This final act marks the end of the journey and will put your skills to the ultimate test.

[*] [b]Enemies in Act 1 can now leave buildings:[/b] More danger, more excitement.

[h3]
Technical Optimizations:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Performance improvements:[/b] Smoother gameplay on high-performance systems.
[*] [b]V-Sync option: [/b]Improved graphical stability for seamless visuals.

[list]
[*] Shadows flicker in certain areas.
[*] Enemy AI occasionally jumps in unexpected spots.
[/list]
[b]I am actively working on addressing these issues and look forward to your feedback![/b]

notes.title: Patch 0.4 Incoming – Act 3 Launches on December 6th!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I’m excited to share with you that [b]Patch 0.4[/b] will be released on [b]December 6th[/b]! This update marks a major milestone: the final [b]Act 3[/b]. Dive into the narrow alleys and face the last challenges of this journey.

Patch 0.4 not only introduces the new act but also brings numerous improvements and features:

[list]
[*] [b]New NPCs and enemies[/b] for added variety.
[*] [b]Hiding in lockers[/b] to evade threats.
[*] A [b]stat tracking system[/b] to monitor your progress.
[*] Technical improvements and much more.
[/list]


As a solo developer, I want to thank you for joining me on this journey. I’m eager to hear your feedback!

smi.

notes.title: „Im Bann der Dunklen Jagd“ – Now Available!
notes.content:
I’m excited to introduce my game, Im Bann der Dunklen Jagd! You and a friend can now dive into this dark co-op horror experience. Play as two detectives exploring an eerie setting, searching for hidden clues, and escaping lurking dangers. Random events ensure each playthrough is unique, keeping the suspense alive.

[b]Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Thrilling 2-player co-op gameplay
[*] Random elements that make each round different
[*] A dense, atmospheric setting to immerse you
[*] Gameplay that rewards attentiveness and teamwork
[/list]

Your impressions and feedback mean a lot to me, and I look forward to hearing about your experiences in the world of In the Grip of the Dark Hunt. Thank you to everyone supporting the game – and good luck on the hunt!

notes.title: Early Access Release – Patchnotes
notes.content:
[h3]New Content & Features:[/h3]
- [b]Act 2 Levels:[/b] Brand new in Early Access! Explore a variety of new features. After completing Act 2, a hidden discovery awaits you upon re-entering the level.
- [b]New Enemies:[/b] Prepare for fresh challenges with brand new enemy types.
- [b]Brightness Option:[/b] You can now adjust the brightness to your preference.
- [b]Game now mostly available in English:[/b] All text and subtitles have been translated into English. However, the voice lines remain in the original language, with translated English subtitles.
- [b]Brighter Flashlight:[/b] The flashlight is now much brighter for improved visibility.
- [b]Improved Enemy Animations:[/b] Enemies now move more fluidly and realistically.
- [b]New Main Menu and Lobby:[/b] Enjoy a revamped main menu and an all-new lobby.
- [b]New Voice Lines and Story Elements:[/b] Expanded storylines with new dialogue and narrative elements.
- [b]New Achievements:[/b] More challenges for you to conquer.
- [b]Longer Sprint Duration:[/b] Your character can now sprint for a longer period.
- [b]Act 1 & Act 1.1:[/b] Minor tweaks for an enhanced player experience.
- [b]New Random Events in Act 1:[/b] Randomized events add more variety and surprises.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
- [b]Post-Death Interaction:[/b] Fixed the issue where players could continue interacting after death.
- [b]Important Items Not Syncing:[/b] Fixed synchronization issues with key items in multiplayer.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Known Issues:[/h3]
- [b]Repeated voice prompt at corpse in bonus level:[/b] This bug currently always occurs.
- [b]Desk chair not synced in the lobby:[/b] A specific desk chair causes visual inconsistencies.

[hr][/hr]
